label: rem:photonic-hall
title: Photonic quantum Hall effect and $q$-deformed braiding
html: Experiments demonstrate a quantized Hall drift in photonic Chern insulators. In the QOU framework, bosons are purely horizontal q-harmonic forms (boson). The Hall conductance arises from the Chern number of the bulk bundle restricted to the horizontal distribution. The q-deformation modifies the quantisation condition. It predicts fractional corrections of order 1 - q^{-1} to the Hall conductance.
